title: Stochstic Sampling for Generative Diffusion Models: From Euler-Maruyama to Higher-Order Schemes
summary: We develop a convergence analysis for generative diffusion models that simultaneously accounts for the three principal sources of error in stochastic sampling: initialization error, score-matching error, and discretization of the reverse-time SDE. Our central tool is the notion of a general strong scheme, a broad class of discretization methods for the reverse dynamics defined via explicit, index-wise tolerances on their Itô-Taylor coefficients.
